import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a bar chart to visualize the distribution of sleep duration
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Person ID', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Person ID')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between stress level and sleep quality
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Stress Level vs Sleep Quality')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Quality')
plt.legend(title='Person ID')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot to compare the distribution of daily steps across different occupation groups
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Occupation', y='Daily Steps', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Daily Steps Distribution by Occupation')
plt.xlabel('Occupation')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to visualize the distribution of heart rate
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(sleep_health['Heart Rate'], bins=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Heart Rate Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
